thesis: Risk-adjusted medium-term momentum: favor assets with strong 20-day momentum relative to their 20-day volatility.
Blend short-term returns with medium-term momentum to capture persistent trends while avoiding unstable volatility division.
Use a contrarian spread between short-term returns and medium-term momentum, reversing the prior trend-following blend in response to negative ICs while retaining moderate weights.

Use a weighted additive blend emphasizing the stronger medium-term momentum signal while retaining a modest short-term return component, avoiding noisy cancellation and targeting more stable, lower-turnover performance.

Use momentum_20d as the primary signal and subtract volatility_20d to favor stable momentum exposures, with the goal of improving predictive performance, Sharpe, and turnover relative to the negatively performing additive blend.
